answer_1.quote: Instruction tuning serves as a promising method, involving the fine-tuning of LLMs using training data and instructions from a collection of upstream tasks.

answer_2.quote: For ELI5 and LF-Test, we followed  to calculate the Rouge-L  and Meteor  scores. These scores are computed by comparing the model outputs with the provided references in the respective datasets. For Super-NI, we utilize Bert-Score  for evaluation instead of other long-text metrics like Rouge.

answer_3.quote: We employed GPT-4 for evaluation on ELI5, LF-Test, and Super-NI benchmarks. We calculated the win/tie/lose rates by comparing the model responses with the reference responses provided by the benchmarks.

answer_4.quote: We randomly select 50 examples from each dataset and manually evaluate their quality. Since the generated tasks may involve knowledge from several different domains, we require that the annotator needs to retrieve the corresponding evidence using the search engines and compare them one by one.
